name: alertmouse
description: Enter keywords and see whenever your name, brand, products, competitors, or phrases of interest are mentioned. Get scores, URLs, snippets, and over-time graphs of your chosen keyword(s) use on the web over time, with spam and duplicates automatically filtered out.

defaultPrompt: Show the mentions I've received in the last 30 days that would make for the best testimonials and endorsements
Surface mentions that may need attention, especially negative press, complaints, or social media
Compare sources where my competitors are getting mentions vs where I am and identify opportunities for future outreach/coverage
interface.longDescription: Enter keywords and see whenever your name, brand, products, competitors, or phrases of interest are mentioned. Get scores, URLs, snippets, and over-time graphs of your chosen keyword(s) use on the web over time, with spam and duplicates automatically filtered out.

positive.prompt: What alerts are set up in my Alertmouse account?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the alerts for Rand Fishkin, SparkToro, and BuzzSumo.

positive.prompt: Summarize mentions of Rand Fishkin from the last 3 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes available mentions from the requested period, citing source links. If none match, clearly reports that no matching mentions were found.

positive.prompt: Show me recent Rand Fishkin mentions with a score of at least 50, and explain which ones might deserve my attention.
positive.expected_behavior: Requests mentions with min_score: 50. Highlights available results and explains their potential relevance using the returned titles and snippets, with source links. Reports no matching results if none qualify.

positive.prompt: Compare the recent mentions of SparkToro and BuzzSumo. What differences do you see in the sources and topics?
positive.expected_behavior: Compares the available mentions and cites supporting sources.

positive.prompt: Summarize my recent mentions for Talkwalker.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that no Talkwalker alert exists in the connected account. Asks the user to create one on alertmouse.com and return.

negative.prompt: What does the company SparkToro do, and who are its main competitors?

negative.description: Analyze text supplied by the user
negative.prompt: Classify this mention as positive, neutral, or negative: 'SparkToro helped us find the right audience, and the pricing was reasonable.'
Remind me tomorrow morning to check for new SparkToro mentions.
